XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sporadic and involuntary shifting into neutral with difficulty engaging low gears.
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: GROUP | GEARBOX | ROBOTISED | B10AA | P2914 | TIMES | N | PASSES | AUTONOMOUSLY | NEUTRAL | CHANGES | SCRATCHES | SCRATCHED | FIRST | SECOND | THIRD | GEAR | IRREGULAR | AUTOMATIC | MANUAL |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Applicability: Cars fitted with a robotised gearbox

  • System: Gearbox

  • Component: Gearbox and automated gearbox unit

  • Fault: Occasionally, the gearbox shifts into neutral on its own and experiences difficulty engaging lower gears (grinding)

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • P2914 (Electric motor 5 – Fault)
    • P2917 (Proxy/network alignment – Failed, mismatch)
  • Cause: Malfunctioning gearbox and gearbox control unit

• Intervention: Check the condition and correct functioning of the gearbox and its robotic unit; if necessary, proceed with its overhaul or replacement.

  • Procedure:

  • Note: In the case in question, only the overhaul of the components was necessary to definitively resolve the anomaly.
